title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: one transport document in force per booking
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents rule aggregates transport documents per booking. It applies when a new draft document is to be created for a booking and when a document of a booking is voided.

## Formal clause

1. Documents are aggregated per booking. A booking has at most one transport document in force, where "in force" means any status other than voided (draft, approved, issued, surrendered, released or accomplished).
2. A new draft for a booking may be created only when every earlier document of that booking is voided.
3. The switch bill is the one case in which a second document is prepared for the same booking: its draft may be created while the exchanged document is surrendered, and the exchanged document is voided when the switch bill is issued, so that the one-in-force rule holds again from that moment.
4. When a booking is cancelled, its document is voided if it is still draft or approved. An issued document of a cancelled booking cannot occur, because cargo is never shipped on a cancelled booking.

## Basis of evidence

The judgement is made from the company's own records before the draft is created: the booking reference each document covers and the status of every earlier document of that booking. The booking of the new draft is the booking the check is made against.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the booking of the requested new draft and the statuses of all earlier documents on that booking.
- **Judgement:** is every earlier document of the booking voided?
- **Output:** if yes, a new draft may be created; if any earlier document is in any other status, no new draft is created for that booking, except the switch bill draft described in clause 3.

## Points of judgement (hypothetical cases)

| Earlier documents on the booking | New ordinary draft allowed? |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One, voided | Yes |
| One voided and one in draft | No |
| One issued | No |
| One surrendered, and the request is for a switch bill draft | Yes, as the switch bill case, subject to the switch bill rules |
